name: Morph V3 Fast
title: Morph V3 Fast: price, context window and specs
answer: Morph V3 Fast is a model in Morph's Morph family, first listed on 2025-07-07. It takes text in and returns text, with a context window of 81K tokens and up to 38K tokens of output. On the lowest-cost route in the OpenRouter catalog it costs $0.8 per million input tokens and $1.2 per million output tokens. Its weights are not published, so it is reached through an API.
compare: It is the oldest of the 2 versions of Morph still listed.
Its input price is below the family median of $0.9 per million tokens.
